fields.name: slug
fields.label: Location ID
fields.description: Set once when the location was created. Changing it breaks the web address and every link to it.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Full name
fields.description: The complete name, as it appears at the top of the location page. For example: Lummi Bay Market at Exit 260.

fields.name: navLabel
fields.label: Short name (menus and cards)
fields.description: Two or three words. For example: Exit 260.

fields.name: shortLabel
fields.label: Shortest name (fuel price table)
fields.description: The tightest version, used only where space is very tight. Fisherman’s Cove becomes "The Cove" here. Leave blank if the short name already fits.

fields.name: aka
fields.label: Also known as
fields.description: Any older or local name people still use.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone number
fields.description: The store’s number. At Exit 260 this is the C-Store line — the Truck Stop has its own, further down.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Hours
fields.description: The normal opening hours, short form: "6am–9pm", or "Open 24 hours". Keep it short — it has to fit on one line on a phone.

fields.name: hoursOverrides
fields.label: Temporary hours (holidays, closures)
fields.description: Usually empty. Use this for a short-term change — New Year’s Eve, a storm, a remodel. Type it weeks ahead: it starts and stops on its own, in Pacific time. For a permanent change, edit the Hours field above instead.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Hours during this period
fields.description: Short form, like "6am–4pm" or "Closed". This replaces the normal hours everywhere they appear.

fields.name: reason
fields.label: Reason (two or three words)
fields.description: Shown on the location page only, never on the short cards. For example: "Christmas Day".

fields.name: startsAt
fields.label: First day (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.description: The first whole day these hours apply, Pacific time.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.label: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.description: The last whole day these hours apply, Pacific time. Required — without an end date the temporary hours would never go away on their own.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: One or two sentences about this place
fields.description: What makes this stop different, in a customer’s words. Shown on the contact page under the name. Leave it blank rather than writing something vague — the section simply omits it.

fields.name: cardLine
fields.label: One-line summary (street, then hours)
fields.description: What shows under the name on the short cards, for example "4839 Rural Ave · Open 24 hours". It is one line and it cuts off rather than wrapping, so keep it tight.

fields.name: amenities
fields.label: What’s here
fields.description: One thing per line — "Car wash", "Propane", "Hot food". Put the reason someone would stop first. Two or more are needed for the badges to show. Do not combine two things in one line.

fields.name: truckStop
fields.label: Truck Stop (Exit 260 only)
fields.description: The Truck Stop is a separate fuel station for truckers sharing the Exit 260 property — not a service of the store. Its phone, hours and amenities are its own and are never mixed with the store’s. Leave this empty at the other two locations.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Truck Stop phone number
fields.description: A driver asking about showers or the diesel lanes should reach the truck side, not the store.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: One or two sentences about the Truck Stop
fields.description: Shown on the contact page, where the Truck Stop is listed on its own.

fields.name: amenities
fields.label: What’s at the Truck Stop
fields.description: One per line: diesel lanes, DEF, showers, driver lounge, truck parking.

fields.name: hoursOverrides

fields.name: siteAlert
fields.label: Emergency notice
fields.description: A single line across the top of every page, for something urgent and unplanned — a closure, a road out, a power cut. It goes live within seconds. For planned holiday hours use "Temporary hours" on the location instead.

fields.name: active
fields.label: Show the notice
fields.description: Turn this off and the bar disappears completely — it leaves no gap behind.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: The main message
fields.description: One short sentence. For example: "The Minimart is closed today."

fields.name: detail
fields.label: Extra detail
fields.description: Optional second sentence.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link (optional)
fields.description: A page on this site with more information.

fields.name: updated
fields.label: Last updated
fields.description: Shown at the end of the bar on larger screens.

fields.name: careersUrl
fields.label: Careers link
fields.description: Where the footer’s "Careers" link goes. The link text on the site is always the single word "Careers" — it never names the destination.

fields.name: lummiCommercialCompaniesUrl
fields.label: Lummi Commercial Companies link
fields.description: The one place on this site that points to the wider group of companies.

fields.name: extraLinks
fields.label: Extra footer links
fields.description: Add a link to one of the four footer columns. It appears under that column, after the links already there. Do not name Silver Reef, Loomis Trail, Salish Village or any other Lummi business in the link text: other Lummi companies appear on this site only as the one "Lummi Commercial Companies" link, and a link that names one will not be shown.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Link text
fields.description: What visitors read, for example: Gift cards.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Where it goes
fields.description: A page on this site starting with / (for example /rewards), or a full address starting with https://. Outside addresses open in a new tab.

fields.name: social
fields.label: Social accounts
fields.description: Links only — a link, never an embedded feed or follow button. Embedded widgets load code from the social network and set cookies before anyone clicks, which would make the privacy policy’s "this site sets no cookies" untrue. Leave the list empty and the row does not appear at all.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Name for screen readers
fields.description: For example: Facebook.

fields.name: embedCode
fields.label: Map embed code
fields.description: The map does not load until a visitor asks for it, so the page sets no cookies on arrival.

fields.name: stillImage
fields.label: Still picture shown before the map loads

fields.name: backdrop
fields.label: Background watermark
fields.description: A large faint image down one side of the page on desktop. Never shown on phones.

fields.name: opacity
fields.label: How faint (percent)
fields.description: 10 is the tested setting. Higher numbers start to compete with the text.

fields.name: liveMainPage
fields.label: Which home page is live
fields.description: Only the version chosen here is shown to visitors.
